_README: Editable file with monthly Highlights & Lowlights for DAE dashboard.
Edit this file when a new month closes. Save it in the same folder as make_executive_summary.py.
When you run `python make_executive_summary.py`, it reads this file and updates the dashboard.
pnl_notes:  optional extra notes per P&L line (Revenue commentary is auto-generated from Excel data).
HTML allowed in body for formatting:
Months use format Mmm-YY (e.g., May-26, Jun-26). To add a new month, copy any existing block and change the key.
P&L Commentary is AUTO-GENERATED from your Excel using this framework:
Revenue: closed at $X (X% MoM; X% vs Bud) driven by Revenue per Hour, Supply Hours, Trips/Hour, Price/Trip, Active Drivers, Hires/Churn
Gross Profit: from Revenue + OPEX drivers (Driver Payments, Maintenance, Marketing, Uber Take Rate, etc.)
EBITDA: from GP + SG&A drivers (Direct Business Line, Cross Func + Corp G&A, Payroll)
Net Income: from EBITDA + D&A + Interest + Taxes
You only fill highlights/lowlights. P&L commentary updates automatically when Excel data changes.

_TEMPLATE_NEW_MONTH._comment: Copy this block, rename key to e.g. 'May-26', fill in highlights & lowlights.

highlights.title: Revenue Performance
highlights.body: Closed at MXN $52.9m (-20.3% MoM; +6.9% vs Budget), driven by: Revenue per Hour -20.9% MoM ($207 vs $261.6) but +12.5% vs Budget ($207 vs $184) thanks to higher trips per hour (1.46 vs 1.40 Bud) and higher price per trip ($142.0 vs $131.3 Bud).

highlights.title: Uber Co-Branding
highlights.body: Received 3rd co-branding payment from Uber totaling MXN $144k for January after achieving 100% of the 120 EVs target. Scaling to 240 co-branded EVs (100% of Feb target).

highlights.title: World Cup Prep
highlights.body: Active preparation for 2026 World Cup: (i) Vehicle Image Refurbishment + traceability; (ii) WC theme activation (hub branding + driver apparel); (iii) maximizing fleet availability through targeted OOS reduction; (iv) exploring Uber-VEMO joint demand-concentration strategies.

lowlights.title: Performance Ratio

lowlights.title: Hiring
lowlights.body: 603 hires (+27.5% MoM) driven by (i) Maria DAE recruiting AI agent (+30% higher conversion vs fully human process); (ii) lead generation provider delivered 9,107 leads (+55% MoM, +24% vs 2025 historical).

highlights.title: EBITDA YoY

lowlights.title: OPEX

highlights.title: Oro Category Drivers
highlights.body: Oro category closed at 48.3%, the highest share since implementing the new compensation system.

highlights.title: Churn
highlights.body: Total churn closed at 34.7% (-3.2 p.p. MoM), driven by a reduction in involuntary exits (-6 p.p. MoM).

highlights.title: Unit Impulse Program
highlights.body: In May we kicked off the Unit Impulse Program: semi-new LTO units were injected into DAE, with an increase of +60 shifts in San Pedro de los Pinos.

lowlights.title: Conversion Rate
lowlights.body: Despite a +30% increase in leads, the conversion rate dropped to 1.3% (-0.3 p.p. WoW).

lowlights.title: Level A Image
lowlights.body: Units with Level A Image closed at 35.9%. An audit with Ops was carried out to re-evaluate unit levels.

lowlights.title: Performance Ratio
lowlights.body: Performance Ratio closed at 70.9% (-2.5 p.p. MoM) — the worst reading since June last year.

lowlights.title: Airport Impound Yards
lowlights.body: Airport impound yards increased to 18, though partially mitigated by a -15% reduction in average days detained per yard.

lowlights.title: Safety Events
lowlights.body: The month recorded 171 safety events, concentrated in low-tenure drivers: 33% with less than 30 days, and 49% with less than 60 days.
